name: What if my roof has pre-existing damage before the storm?

mainEntity.name: What if my roof has pre-existing damage before the storm?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your roof has pre-existing damage, a severe weather assessment will distinguish between old and new damage. Our inspectors are trained to identify characteristics that differentiate storm-related damage from wear and tear or previous issues. While insurance typically covers new storm damage, pre-existing conditions are usually excluded. Our detailed report will clarify which damage appears to be storm-induced, helping you understand what may be covered and what falls outside the scope of a new claim.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our assessment distinguishes new storm damage from pre-existing issues. Insurance typically covers new damage, not pre-existing conditions.
